introHeading: The magazine booth in Jersey City
introParas: Jersey City's waterfront venues give the magazine booth a natural set piece to sit next to — an Exchange Place or Newport reception with the Manhattan skyline in the windows behind the cover frame photographs like an actual magazine shoot. A wedding edition with your names on the masthead is our most-requested cover here, though a fully branded issue works just as well for a corporate event at one of the Hudson-facing hotel ballrooms.

The booth wants a 10ft x 10ft footprint at its best, which the newer waterfront venues around Newport and Exchange Place tend to have, and we compress to 8ft x 8ft for tighter spaces like a Grove Street loft or a McGinley Square hall. We need a standard 110V outlet within 15 feet, and we arrive a full hour before your start time so the cover frame and lighting are tested before guests arrive.

Every cover is designed with you ahead of the event, a trained attendant runs unlimited sessions all night, and the finished cover delivers instantly by text, email or QR code alongside a printed copy from the on-site printer. There is no travel fee for most Jersey City venues — it is a short hop from our Brooklyn base, quoted from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Magazine Booth in Jersey City — FAQ

faqs.q: Can the magazine cover use the Jersey City waterfront as part of the shot?
faqs.a: Yes — Exchange Place and Newport venues that face the Hudson give the cover frame a Manhattan skyline backdrop, and it is one of our favorite setups in the city.

faqs.q: Can we design our own magazine cover?
faqs.a: Yes. The cover is designed with you before the event — names, date, colors and cover lines, or a full brand lockup for corporate work. We send a proof ahead of time either way.

faqs.q: How much space does the magazine booth need?
faqs.a: Optimal setup is 10ft x 10ft, which the newer waterfront venues around Newport and Exchange Place tend to have. We compress to 8ft x 8ft for a tighter Grove Street loft or similar space, and need a standard 110V outlet within 15 feet.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee to Jersey City?
faqs.a: No travel fee for most Jersey City venues — it is a short hop from our Brooklyn base. We quote everything from your venue ZIP code before you book.
About 20 minutes once we arrive. We arrive a full hour before your start time so the frame and lighting are tested before your first guest sees it.

faqs.q: Do guests get a printed cover or a digital one?
faqs.a: Both. Covers print on site from a dye-sublimation printer, and every guest also receives the digital version by text, email or QR code.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for my venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million liability insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.

faqs.q: How much does a magazine booth rental cost in Jersey City?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on how many hours you need and your specific venue, rather than a flat rate card. The quote form returns a real number in about 30 seconds, and additional hours beyond your booked time are $125 per hour.
